essence: Win the contest before the battle, and keep your own side whole.
modern_lens: Chapter 3 ranks outcomes: the best result costs you nothing, because the other side changes course without a fight. Modern work and personal conflicts can often be settled by reshaping the other side's options rather than out-shouting them. The chapter also insists that you know both the other party and yourself, which is the basis of any honest negotiation.

principles.name: Win Without Fighting
principles.gloss: The best result breaks resistance before any contest starts. Change the options in front of the other side rather than forcing their hand.

principles.name: Avoid the Costly Siege
principles.gloss: Direct assaults on entrenched positions are the most expensive route. Look for a smaller, faster way around the wall.

principles.name: Know Both Sides
principles.gloss: Knowing the other party and knowing yourself decides most outcomes. Ignorance on either side turns every contest into a gamble.

principles.name: Leave When Outmatched
principles.gloss: When the odds are clearly against you, withdraw with your strength intact and choose a different ground.
